description: The videos follow a silent man (John Plant) as he builds tools, shelters, and other structures entirely from scratch using only natural materials like clay, stone, and plant fibers, without any modern tools or materials. There is no speaking or music, viewers simply watch the step-by-step construction process, from making a stone axe to building a hut with a tiled roof and underfloor heating, accompanied only by ambient forest sounds. Make sure closed captions are turned on while watching.
